calls.reason: No one could inspect the image or the full prompt, and no independent audit counted the errors. That leaves only Marcus's own answer key, which cannot prove itself.

T2I-CompBench (July 2023) and GenEval (Oct 2023) show that high-quality image generators still fail often at spatial relations and attribute binding. In GenEval the best model got only 15% of relative-position prompts right.

Chain-of-Verification shows that checking reduces hallucinations, and Kalai and Vempala give a different statistical account. Neither tests Marcus's fragment-reconstruction explanation, so the causal claim stays unsettled.

Carlini et al. and Somepalli et al. show that diffusion models memorize and copy training data. Neither tests whether a missing originality check explains the copying, so the causal claim is unresolved.
